title: [Runner] Fix false-positive Win+Shift+C shortcut conflict on Windows 11

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The invocation binding was verified with the actual parameter block. The latest attempt passed Notifications projection but stopped in the Updating dependency build. Investigation confirmed the dependency header exists; a validation-only build hook had displaced the repository's vcpkg integration. The hook must preserve the repository imports before retrying the absolute generated-file path correction. Product source and the literal candidate are unchanged; Runner, native tests, and discovery did not run, and no passing result is claimed.
